record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.context_brief: Existence for admissible local invariant values
record.original_question: For a chosen local numerical invariant of vector bundles near a contractible subvariety, which of the admissible values are actually realized by some vector bundle?

evidence.quote: Question 17. Which admissible values of the local invariant are realized by some vector bundle?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y \subset X$ be a contractible subvariety inside a smooth complex algebraic variety $X$ (i.e., there exists a proper birational morphism $\pi : X 	o X'$ contracting $Y$ to a point and being an isomorphism on $X \setminus Y$). For a holomorphic vector bundle $E$ on (a neighborhood of $Y$ in) $X$, fix a chosen notion of local numerical invariant $
u(E)$ associated with the germ of $E$ near $Y$ (for instance, the local holomorphic Euler characteristic $h^1(\pi_*\mathcal{E}nd(E))$, the width $w(E)$, the height $h(E)$, or any analogous local Chern-class–type invariant). Suppose the values that $
u(E)$ can take are constrained by a known set of necessary inequalities and divisibility/parity conditions coming from the restriction $E|_Y$ and from cohomological bounds; call a tuple of values satisfying all such necessary conditions admissible.

Determine, among all admissible values, exactly which ones are realized by some holomorphic vector bundle $E$ on a neighborhood of $Y$. Equivalently, given an admissible value $v$, decide whether there exists a holomorphic vector bundle $E$ near $Y$ with $
u(E) = v$, and characterize the realizable subset of admissible values.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as one of 25 open questions in a 2021 survey on vector bundles and their moduli, asking which admissible values of local numerical invariants near a contractible subvariety are actually realized by some bundle. No published full solution was located; related works address bounds and partial realizations (e.g. local holomorphic Euler characteristic on small resolutions), but the realization problem in general remains open.

status_evidence.title: 25 open questions about vector bundles and their moduli (E. Ballico)
status_evidence.snippet: Once a specific concept of local invariant has been chosen, asks what are the admissible numerical values ... examines which intermediate values actually occur for some bundle.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of realization of admissible local-invariant values for vector bundles near a contractible subvariety is listed as an open question.
